actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished. Let's keep contributions high!

But need nonnegative absolute units limited by wallet. So contribute 140.75 (all). That satisfies extra push. Also communication: round 1 is first round, need broadcast norm. Provide message.
